function.name: run_action
function.description:
Run one analysis action.
count_in(layers=[points, areas]): Count points in each area. Point-in-area count. New layer: areas with field '<points layer name, lowercase>'.
count_here(layers=[points], object=area): Count points here. Point-in-area count.
which_container(layers=[areas], object=point): Which area is it in. Point in area.
whats_inside(layers=[layer], object=area): What's inside. Everything that touches or lies inside the area. Shows only the objects inside.
summarize_data_here(layers=[layer], object=area): Summarize data here. Counts and value summaries of what touches or lies inside the area.
buffer(layers=[layer], object?=object, distance, merge): Show an area within a distance. Straight-line distance: a geodesic buffer on the WGS 84 ellipsoid. New area layer.
measure_area(object=area): Measure its area. Geodesic area on the WGS 84 ellipsoid.
measure_length(object=line): Measure length. Geodesic length on the WGS 84 ellipsoid.
summarize_each(layers=[raster, areas], band): Summarize raster in each area. Area-weighted mean, minimum and maximum with fractional cell coverage, each cell weighted by its area on the ellipsoid. New layer: areas with fields '<raster> mean', '<raster> min', '<raster> max'.
summarize_here(layers=[raster], object=area, band): Summarize raster here. Area-weighted mean with fractional cell coverage, each cell weighted by its area on the ellipsoid.
summarize_drawn(layers=[raster], object?=area, band): Summarize in an area I draw. Area-weighted mean with fractional cell coverage inside the drawn area. Omit area to let the user draw one.
add_raster_values(layers=[raster, points], band): Add raster values to each point. The value of the raster cell containing each point, with scale and offset applied. Adds field '<raster name>' to the points.
rank_by_value(layers=[layer], field): Rank a layer by a value. A sort by the value.

layers.description: layer names, in the action's order

function.name: filter
function.description: Show only a layer's objects meeting all conditions (replaces its filter; [] clears). Later actions use only shown objects.

function.name: color_by
function.description: Color a layer by a field's values.

function.name: zoom_to
function.description: Zoom to and select a layer, or one object.

function.name: ask_user
function.description: Ask one question when the request is ambiguous.

function.name: cannot_do
function.description: The tools can't answer this; say why.
